<!-- ===== OLGA MASLOVA · PRESS MAGAZINE · Tilda block T123 ===== -->
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;0,800;1,400;1,500&family=Montserrat:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<div class="omz" id="omz">
  <div class="omz__stage">
    <div class="omz__book" aria-live="polite"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="omz__nav">
    <button type="button" class="omz__btn" data-go="prev" aria-label="Previous page">&#8592;</button>
    <div class="omz__count"></div>
    <button type="button" class="omz__btn" data-go="next" aria-label="Next page">&#8594;</button>
  </div>
  <div class="omz__hint">Click or swipe to turn the page</div>
</div>

<style>
.omz{--paper:#f4efe6;--ink:#141210;--wine:#6e1522;--muted:#8a8178;background:#000;color:#fff;padding:40px 0 34px;
  font-family:'Montserrat','TildaSans',Arial,sans-serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow:hidden;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
.omz *{box-sizing:border-box}
.omz__stage{display:flex;justify-content:center;perspective:2400px}
.omz__book{position:relative;transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.4,.1,.2,1);touch-action:pan-y}
.omz__sheet{position:absolute;top:0;height:100%;transform-style:preserve-3d;transform-origin:left center;
  transition:transform .9s cubic-bezier(.45,.05,.2,1);cursor:pointer}
.omz__sheet.flipped{transform:rotateY(-180deg)}
.omz__face{position:absolute;inset:0;backface-visibility:hidden;-webkit-backface-visibility:hidden;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink)}
.omz__face.back{transform:rotateY(180deg)}
.omz__face::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,0,0,.18),rgba(0,0,0,0) 7%,rgba(0,0,0,0) 94%,rgba(0,0,0,.06))}
.omz__face.back::after{background:linear-gradient(270deg,rgba(0,0,0,.18),rgba(0,0,0,0) 7%,rgba(0,0,0,0) 94%,rgba(0,0,0,.06))}
.omz__single .omz__face::after{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,0,0,.12),rgba(0,0,0,0) 4%)}
.omz__sheet.moving .omz__face::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:5;pointer-events:none;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,0,0,0),rgba(0,0,0,.22));animation:omzShade .9s ease}
@keyframes omzShade{0%{opacity:0}50%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0}}
.omz__book.shadow::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:4%;right:4%;bottom:-18px;height:30px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,rgba(255,255,255,.08),rgba(0,0,0,0) 70%)}

/* ---------- cover ---------- */
.omz-cover{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#2a0a0f;color:#fff}
.omz-cover img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 30%}
.omz-cover .tint{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(20,3,6,.35) 0%,rgba(20,3,6,0) 26%,rgba(20,3,6,0) 58%,rgba(15,2,4,.78) 100%)}
.omz-cover .gloss{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;mix-blend-mode:screen;
  background:linear-gradient(115deg,rgba(255,255,255,0) 35%,rgba(255,255,255,.32) 47%,rgba(255,255,255,0) 58%);background-size:300% 100%;animation:omzGloss 7s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes omzGloss{0%,55%{background-position:120% 0}100%{background-position:-60% 0}}
.omz-cover .top{position:absolute;left:6%;right:6%;top:3.2%;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:calc(var(--pw)*.021);letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase}
.omz-cover .mast{position:absolute;left:4%;right:4%;top:6.2%;font-family:'Playfair Display','Didot','Bodoni 72',Georgia,serif;font-weight:800;
  font-size:calc(var(--pw)*.235);line-height:.9;letter-spacing:-.02em;text-align:center;text-shadow:0 2px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.omz-cover .lines{position:absolute;left:6%;top:34%;width:34%;font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif}
.omz-cover .lines .q{font-style:italic;font-size:calc(var(--pw)*.043);line-height:1.18}
.omz-cover .lines .by{font-family:'Montserrat',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:calc(var(--pw)*.018);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:.8em;opacity:.85}
.omz-cover .lines .rule{width:30%;height:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.6);margin:1.3em 0}
.omz-cover .lines .roles{font-family:'Montserrat',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:calc(var(--pw)*.02);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.9}
.omz-cover .bottom{position:absolute;left:6%;right:6%;bottom:4.5%}
.omz-cover .name{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-size:calc(var(--pw)*.108);line-height:.95;letter-spacing:.01em}
.omz-cover .sub{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;margin-top:.9em;font-size:calc(var(--pw)*.02);letter-spacing:.25em;text-transform:uppercase}
.omz-cover .sub b{font-weight:600}

/* ---------- inner pages ---------- */
.omz-pg{position:absolute;inset:0;padding:7.5% 9% 6.5%;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.omz-pg .run{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:calc(var(--pw)*.017);letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);
  padding-bottom:.9em;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(20,18,16,.25)}
.omz-pg .kick{margin-top:7%;font-size:calc(var(--pw)*.02);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--wine);font-weight:600;line-height:1.6}
.omz-pg .mark{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;color:var(--wine);font-size:calc(var(--pw)*.2);line-height:.6;height:.42em;margin-top:5%}
.omz-pg .quote{flex:1;min-height:0;overflow:hidden;font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.38;margin-top:3%}
.omz-pg .cred{border-top:1px solid rgba(20,18,16,.25);padding-top:.9em;margin-top:4%;font-size:calc(var(--pw)*.022);line-height:1.5}
.omz-pg .cred .who{font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:calc(var(--pw)*.02)}
.omz-pg .cred .src{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-size:calc(var(--pw)*.03)}
.omz-pg .cred .tr{color:var(--muted);font-size:calc(var(--pw)*.018);margin-top:.2em}
.omz-pg .cred a{display:inline-block;margin-top:.7em;color:var(--wine);text-decoration:none;font-size:calc(var(--pw)*.018);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;border-bottom:1px solid currentColor;padding-bottom:2px}
.omz-pg .folio{position:absolute;bottom:2.6%;font-size:calc(var(--pw)*.018);letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--muted)}
.omz-pg .folio.r{right:9%} .omz-pg .folio.l{left:9%}
/* contents */
.omz-pg .h{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-size:calc(var(--pw)*.085);line-height:1;margin-top:8%}
.omz-pg .lead{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-size:calc(var(--pw)*.03);line-height:1.4;margin:4% 0 5%;color:#3b342e}
.omz-pg .toc{flex:1;min-height:0;overflow:hidden;font-size:calc(var(--pw)*.0205);line-height:1.62}
.omz-pg .toc div{display:flex;gap:.6em;cursor:pointer}
.omz-pg .toc div:hover span:first-child{color:var(--wine)}
.omz-pg .toc span:first-child{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.omz-pg .toc i{flex:1;border-bottom:1px dotted rgba(20,18,16,.35);transform:translateY(-.35em)}
.omz-pg .toc b{font-weight:600;color:var(--wine)}
.omz-pg .note{font-size:calc(var(--pw)*.017);color:var(--muted);margin-top:3%}
/* back cover */
.omz-backc{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#0d0d0d;color:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;text-align:center;padding:10%}
.omz-backc .m{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-weight:800;font-size:calc(var(--pw)*.12);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.omz-backc .t{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-size:calc(var(--pw)*.034);line-height:1.4;margin:6% 0;opacity:.9}
.omz-backc a{color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font-size:calc(var(--pw)*.02);letter-spacing:.25em;text-transform:uppercase;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5);padding-bottom:3px}
.omz-backc .again{margin-top:9%;background:none;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);color:#fff;padding:.9em 1.4em;font-size:calc(var(--pw)*.018);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit}
.omz-blank{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--paper)}

/* nav */
.omz__nav{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:22px;margin-top:26px}
.omz__btn{width:46px;height:46px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.45);background:#000;color:#fff;font-size:18px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s,color .2s}
.omz__btn:hover{background:#fff;color:#000}
.omz__btn:disabled{opacity:.25;cursor:default;background:#000;color:#fff}
.omz__count{min-width:96px;text-align:center;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.25em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75)}
.omz__hint{text-align:center;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.25em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);margin-top:14px}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.omz__sheet{transition:none}.omz-cover .gloss{animation:none;opacity:0}}
</style>

<script>
/* ================== DATA: edit here ==================
   OMZ_PHOTO: cover photo (a link like https://static.tildacdn.com/... also works). */
var OMZ_PHOTO = "data:image/jpeg;base64,";
var OMZ_SITE = "https://olgamaslovaofficial.com";
var OMZ_REVIEWS = [
  {prod:"Turandot · Deutsche Oper am Rhein, Düsseldorf · 2026",
   quote:"She demonstrated that she possesses all the necessary tools to successfully tackle the demanding role of Turandot. Her voice, sumptuous and powerful, asserted itself authoritatively in the upper register and displayed remarkable depth of sound. She commanded the stage with assurance, delivering ‘In questa reggia’ convincingly and deploying a subtle play of colors and accents in the riddle scene.",
   who:"Bernardo Gaitan", src:"OperaWire", date:"11 February 2026", url:"https://operawire.com/deutsche-oper-am-rhein-2025-26-review-turandot/"},
  {prod:"Elvira, Ernani · Teatro Filarmonico, Verona · 2025",
   quote:"Russian soprano Olga Maslova is a vocal phenomenon; one of those rare sopranos who excels in roles as diverse as Violetta in ‘La traviata’ and Imogene in ‘Il pirata’ to the icy princess ‘Turandot.’ If one had to define Maslova’s voice, spinto with facility in all registers would be the most appropriate definition. Endowed with brilliant high notes, her opening aria, ‘Ernani, Ernani involami,’ was spectacular despite the weird staging.",
   who:"Ossama el Naggar", src:"OperaWire", date:"29 December 2025", url:"https://operawire.com/teatro-filarmonico-2025-review-ernani/"},
  {prod:"Aïda · Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, cond. Zubin Mehta · 2025",
   quote:"Though fully capable of unfurling her voice over Verdi’s massive ensemble climaxes, Maslova was more often inclined to dispatch her role’s sweeping melodies with a compact, slender and slightly cool timbre that nevertheless retained both carrying power and center of pitch. It was an Aïda with long, sketched out musical ideas that were greater than the sum of their parts. […] We learn, through her poetically achieved deception of Radames, that Aïda’s capacity for reflection — until now, a feature of her inert passivity — is actually what makes her uniquely powerful. […] The contrast of Baek’s marbled, occasionally baritonal delivery and Maslova’s refined, pearly legato felt both deeply modern but intriguingly old-fashioned.",
   who:"Miles Greenberg", src:"Parterre Box", date:"14 July 2025", url:"https://parterre.com/2025/07/14/canonically-ossified/"},
  {prod:"Abigaille, Nabucco (concert, with Plácido Domingo) · Salle Gaveau, Paris · 2024",
   quote:"Having already taken on the role in Russia and Greece, and very recently in Trieste, Olga Maslova shows a most appreciable ease as the slave-usurper. An Abigaille-Turandot in the line of Callas, Cerquetti (who never sang the ice princess) and Dimitrova, she has the look for it too. She throws all her vehemence into the Act I trio, standing out at once with excellent command of the top of the register and a skilful legato. In her great Act II scene she knows how to vary the colours of the recitative, making the ductility of her phrasing hit hard when it comes to inspiring terror. Beautifully spun notes make the cavatina airborne, while the cabaletta, all of a piece, is adorned with seductive trills. Moving in death, she once again calls on an exceptional filato. […] An imperious Abigaille.",
   who:"Camillo Faverzani", src:"Première Loge", date:"6 April 2024", tr:"Translated from French", url:"https://www.premiereloge-opera.com/?p=118430"},
  {prod:"XVII International Tchaikovsky Competition · 2023",
   quote:"A dramatic soprano of the purest grade: such voices are born once in several decades, and managers all over the world chase after them.",
   who:"Vladimir Dudin", src:"Kommersant", date:"1 July 2023", tr:"Translated from Russian · print edition"},
  {prod:"Abigaille, Nabucco · Arena di Verona · 2026",
   quote:"The star of the evening was Russian soprano Olga Maslova as Abigaille, combining fiendish dramatic power with exquisitely controlled pianissimos to reveal the tragedy of the opera’s most complex character. Possessing a splendid timbre, a vibrant chest voice and unwavering high notes, she is also a compelling actress whose magnetic stage presence dominates every scene. […] the enduring memory of Olga Maslova’s dazzling vocal performance.",
   who:"Alina Bottez", src:"Plays to See", date:"28 July 2026", url:"https://playstosee.com/?p=70774"},
  {prod:"Turandot · Bayerische Staatsoper, Munich, with Jonas Kaufmann · 2026",
   quote:"The Russian dramatic soprano Olga Maslova has established herself in recent years as one of the rising interpreters of the title role. […] The voice is powerful; it cuts effortlessly through the imposing flood of orchestral sound, with brilliant, vigorous high notes that spring from the base of a solid middle register of refined colours. Olga Maslova conveys with nuance the emotional journey of the ice princess, a path marked by the fear of vulnerability that makes her raise herself into an impregnable citadel, a fortress that finally cracks and bursts open volcanically. Beneath the princess’s inhuman shell, the singer reveals the torments of a wounded woman.",
   who:"Luc-Henri Roger", src:"Munich & Co (via Paperblog)", date:"16 June 2026", tr:"Translated from French", url:"https://www.paperblog.fr/10738716/une-distribution-etoilee-pour-la-reprise-de-turandot-a-la-bayerische-staatsoper/"},
  {prod:"Gulnara, Il corsaro · Teatro Carlo Felice, Genoa · 2024",
   quote:"A rarity, a Corsaro on stage! […] above all, a pleasant musical surprise, carried by three main protagonists: the conductor Renato Palumbo and the two title roles, Francesco Meli and Olga Maslova. […] Facing him — and this is undoubtedly the most complex and interesting duet of the work — soprano Olga Maslova is an impressive Gulnara, as much for the quality and power of her voice as for the intensity of her dramatic acting. Superb, her entrance on the cavatina at the start of Act II, at once airborne and combative, set off sustained applause.",
   who:"Marie Gaboriaud", src:"Première Loge", date:"21 May 2024", tr:"Translated from French", url:"https://www.premiereloge-opera.com/?p=121210"},
  {prod:"Turandot · Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, cond. Zubin Mehta · 2024",
   quote:"Soprano Olga Maslova is a Turandot of substantial but well-managed vocal means, malleable and rich in nuance, far removed from the screaming Turandots one often hears.",
   who:"Roberta Manetti", src:"Première Loge", date:"27 April 2024", tr:"Translated from French", url:"https://www.premiereloge-opera.com/?p=119292"},
  {prod:"Abigaille, Nabucco · Mariinsky Theatre, St. Petersburg · 2023",
   quote:"The appearance of Olga Maslova, soloist of the Primorsky Stage of the Mariinsky Theatre, born in Voronezh, proved that our land is still generous with such fabulous operatic talents.",
   who:"", src:"Sankt-Peterburgskie Vedomosti", date:"15 March 2023", tr:"Translated from Russian · print edition"},
  {prod:"Hibla Gerzmava International Competition · 2023",
   quote:"Dramatic soprano Olga Maslova from Voronezh, now a soloist of the Mariinsky’s Primorsky Stage, immediately caught the attention. In Liza’s aria from The Queen of Spades she showed high academic polish and the heartfelt warmth typical of the Russian vocal school, somewhat recalling the legendary pre-war Bolshoi soprano Ksenia Derzhinskaya. In […] Abigaille’s aria from Nabucco she astonished with technical brilliance and a charismatic dramatic delivery.",
   who:"Alexander Matusevich", src:"Kultura", date:"23 January 2023", tr:"Translated from Russian · print edition"},
  {prod:"Hibla Gerzmava International Competition, final round · 2023",
   quote:"The brilliant Olga Maslova sang Liza’s aria from Tchaikovsky’s The Queen of Spades in the finest traditions of the Russian vocal school; listening to her, one was even reminded of Tamara Milashkina’s benchmark Liza.",
   who:"Filipp Geller", src:"ClassicalMusicNews.ru", date:"21 January 2023", tr:"Translated from Russian", url:"https://www.classicalmusicnews.ru/reports/gerzmava-competition-2023-vocal-final-round/"},
  {prod:"Hibla Gerzmava International Competition, first round · 2023",
   quote:"Olga Maslova is a ready-made prima donna. It seems that her powerful voice can do anything.",
   who:"Filipp Geller", src:"ClassicalMusicNews.ru", date:"16 January 2023", tr:"Translated from Russian", url:"https://www.classicalmusicnews.ru/reports/gerzmava-competition-2023-1-round/"},
  {prod:"Turandot (role debut) · Primorsky Stage of the Mariinsky Theatre, Vladivostok · 2022",
   quote:"But what a strong Turandot Olga Maslova was in this performance! The voice, bright, powerful, even at the highest pitch with the strongest Damascus steel. It was not without reason that the hall literally responded with shouts of bravo after every aria!",
   who:"Tatjana Pavlova", src:"Operius", date:"22 May 2022", url:"https://www.operius.de/post/rezension-turandot-an-der-primorsky-b%C3%BChne-in-wladiwostok-%D0%BE%D0%B1%D0%B7%D0%BE%D1%80-%D1%82%D1%83%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B4%D0%BE%D1%82-%D0%B2%D0%BE-%D0%B2%D0%BB%D0%B0%D0%B4%D0%B8%D0%B2%D0%BE%D1%81%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%BA%D0%B5"},
  {prod:"Cio-Cio-San, Madama Butterfly · Teatro Verdi, Trieste · 2026",
   quote:"Olga Maslova in the title role, bringing nuance to Cio-Cio-San’s fragility and resolve.",
   who:"Maria Kochetkova", src:"InTrieste", date:"3 April 2026", url:"https://intrieste.com/2026/04/03/puccinis-madama-butterfly-brings-trieste-to-tears/"},
  {prod:"Aïda · Arena di Verona, cond. Daniel Oren · 2025",
   quote:"The solo cast was led by the excellent Olga Maslova as Aïda, alongside Yusif Eyvazov as Radamès. Already in the first act, both of them enchanted with their arias ‘Ritorna vincitor’ and ‘Celeste Aida’, and set a standard that some of the other soloists could not reach.",
   who:"Igor Vlajnić", src:"Novi list", date:"3 September 2025", tr:"Translated from Croatian", url:"https://www.novilist.hr/?p=1524810"},
  {prod:"Turandot · Sferisterio, Macerata Opera Festival · 2024",
   quote:"A most exquisite and cruel Olga Maslova […] stood out powerfully against the equally extraordinary Calaf of Angelo Villari […] Two voices that blended well in their opposition.",
   who:"Livia Bidoli", src:"GothicNetwork", date:"16 August 2024", tr:"Translated from Italian", url:"https://gothicnetwork.org/printpdf/17463"},
  {prod:"Abigaille, Nabucco · Teatro Verdi, Trieste, cond. Daniel Oren · 2024",
   quote:"Although the premiere cast was led by Maria José Siri as Abigaille, Saturday’s performance brought the brilliant Olga Maslova to the stage in that role. Maslova sang the demanding part with bravura, also offering very good stage acting.",
   who:"Igor Vlajnić", src:"Novi list", date:"26 March 2024", tr:"Translated from Croatian", url:"https://www.novilist.hr/?p=1185498"}
];
/* ===================================================== */

(function(){
  var root=document.getElementById('omz'); if(!root) return;
  var bookEl=root.querySelector('.omz__book'), countEl=root.querySelector('.omz__count');
  var prevB=root.querySelector('[data-go=prev]'), nextB=root.querySelector('[data-go=next]');
  var RATIO=1.38, ratio=1.38, pos=0, sheets=[], spread=true, pw=0, ph=0, busy=false;

  function el(tag,cls,text){ var e=document.createElement(tag); if(cls) e.className=cls; if(text!=null) e.textContent=text; return e; }
  function add(p,c){ p.appendChild(c); return c; }

  /* ---------- page builders ---------- */
  function cover(){
    var f=el('div','omz-cover');
    var img=add(f,el('img')); img.src=OMZ_PHOTO; img.alt='Olga Maslova'; img.draggable=false;
    add(f,el('div','tint'));
    var top=add(f,el('div','top')); add(top,el('span',null,'Selected Press')); add(top,el('span',null,'2022 – 2026'));
    add(f,el('div','mast','REVIEWS'));
    var l=add(f,el('div','lines'));
    add(l,el('div','q','“A dramatic soprano of the purest grade”'));
    add(l,el('div','by','Kommersant'));
    add(l,el('div','rule'));
    var ro=add(l,el('div','roles')); ['Turandot','Abigaille','Aïda','Lady Macbeth','Lisa'].forEach(function(t){ add(ro,el('div',null,t)); });
    var b=add(f,el('div','bottom'));
    add(b,el('div','name','Olga Maslova'));
    var s=add(b,el('div','sub')); add(s,el('span',null,'Soprano')); var o=add(s,el('b',null,'Open →'));
    add(f,el('div','gloss'));
    return f;
  }
  function run(pg,n){ var r=add(pg,el('div','run')); add(r,el('span',null,'Olga Maslova')); add(r,el('span',null,'Reviews')); }
  function folio(pg,n){ add(pg,el('div','folio '+(spread&&n%2===0?'l':'r'),String(n).padStart(2,'0'))); }
  function contents(n){
    var pg=el('div','omz-pg'); run(pg,n);
    add(pg,el('div','h','In this issue'));
    add(pg,el('div','lead',OMZ_REVIEWS.length+' critics on the voice of Olga Maslova, from Vladivostok to Verona.'));
    var t=add(pg,el('div','toc'));
    OMZ_REVIEWS.forEach(function(r,i){ var row=add(t,el('div')); var p=r.prod.split(' · ');
      add(row,el('span',null,p[0]+' · '+p[p.length-1])); add(row,el('i')); add(row,el('b',null,String(i+3).padStart(2,'0')));
      row.setAttribute('data-page',i+2); });
    add(pg,el('div','note','Translations from French, Italian, Croatian and Russian are marked as such.'));
    folio(pg,n); return pg;
  }
  function review(r,n){
    var pg=el('div','omz-pg'); run(pg,n);
    add(pg,el('div','kick',r.prod));
    add(pg,el('div','mark','“'));
    var q=add(pg,el('div','quote',r.quote));
    var c=add(pg,el('div','cred'));
    if(r.who) add(c,el('div','who',r.who));
    add(c,el('div','src',r.src+', '+r.date));
    if(r.tr) add(c,el('div','tr',r.tr));
    if(r.url){ var a=add(c,el('a',null,'Read the review →')); a.href=r.url; a.target='_blank'; a.rel='noopener'; }
    folio(pg,n); return pg;
  }
  function backCover(){
    var f=el('div','omz-backc');
    add(f,el('div','m','Olga Maslova'));
    add(f,el('div','t','Soprano. Turandot, Abigaille, Aïda, Lady Macbeth, Lisa.'));
    var a=add(f,el('a',null,'olgamaslovaofficial.com')); a.href=OMZ_SITE; a.target='_blank'; a.rel='noopener';
    var g=add(f,el('button','again','Back to the cover')); g.type='button'; g.setAttribute('data-page',0);
    return f;
  }
  function pages(){ var list=[cover,function(){return contents(2);}];
    OMZ_REVIEWS.forEach(function(r,i){ list.push(function(){return review(r,i+3);}); });
    list.push(backCover); return list; }

  /* ---------- fit long quotes ---------- */
  function fit(){
    root.querySelectorAll('.omz-cover .mast').forEach(function(m){ var size=pw*.235; m.style.fontSize=size+'px'; m.style.whiteSpace='nowrap';
      var g=0; while(m.scrollWidth>m.clientWidth+1 && g++<30){ size*=.96; m.style.fontSize=size+'px'; } });
    root.querySelectorAll('.omz-pg .quote').forEach(function(q){
      var len=q.textContent.length, k=160>len?.068:300>len?.058:480>len?.05:650>len?.044:.04;
      var size=pw*k; q.style.fontSize=size+'px';
      var guard=0; while(q.scrollHeight>q.clientHeight+1 && size>9 && guard++<40){ size*=.95; q.style.fontSize=size+'px'; }
    });
  }

  /* ---------- build book ---------- */
  function layout(){
    var avail=Math.min(root.clientWidth-24,1100), vh=window.innerHeight||800;
    spread=avail>=700;
    var maxH=vh*(spread?.8:.78);
    ratio=spread?RATIO:1.5; pw=spread?avail/2:Math.min(avail,460); ph=pw*ratio;
    if(ph>maxH){ ph=maxH; pw=ph/ratio; }
    pw=Math.round(pw); ph=Math.round(ph);
  }
  function build(keepPage){
    layout();
    bookEl.innerHTML=''; sheets=[];
    bookEl.style.width=(spread?pw*2:pw)+'px'; bookEl.style.height=ph+'px';
    bookEl.style.setProperty('--pw',pw+'px'); root.style.setProperty('--pw',pw+'px');
    root.classList.toggle('omz__single',!spread);
    var P=pages(), n=spread?Math.ceil(P.length/2):P.length;
    for(var k=0;n>k;k++){
      var s=add(bookEl,el('div','omz__sheet'));
      s.style.left=(spread?pw:0)+'px'; s.style.width=pw+'px';
      var fr=add(s,el('div','omz__face front')), bk=add(s,el('div','omz__face back'));
      var fi=spread?2*k:k, bi=spread?2*k+1:-1;
      if(P[fi]) fr.appendChild(P[fi]());
      if(bi>=0&&P[bi]) bk.appendChild(P[bi]()); else bk.appendChild(el('div','omz-blank'));
      sheets.push(s);
    }
    /* keep the same page after a resize */
    var page=keepPage||0; pos=spread?Math.ceil(page/2):page; pos=Math.max(0,Math.min(pos,sheets.length));
    apply(true);
    if(document.fonts&&document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(fit); fit();
  }
  function currentPage(){ return spread?Math.max(0,pos*2-1):pos; }
  function apply(instant){
    sheets.forEach(function(s,k){
      if(instant) s.style.transition='none';
      var f=pos>k; s.classList.toggle('flipped',f);
      s.style.zIndex=f?(k+1):(sheets.length-k);
      if(instant){ s.offsetWidth; s.style.transition=''; }
    });
    var shift=0; if(spread){ if(pos===0) shift=-pw/2; else if(pos===sheets.length) shift=pw/2; }
    if(instant) bookEl.style.transition='none';
    bookEl.style.transform='translateX('+shift+'px)';
    if(instant){ bookEl.offsetWidth; bookEl.style.transition=''; }
    var total=pages().length;
    if(spread){ var a=pos*2, b=a+1; countEl.textContent = pos===0?'1 / '+total : pos===sheets.length? total+' / '+total : a+'–'+Math.min(b,total)+' / '+total; }
    else countEl.textContent=(pos+1)+' / '+total;
    prevB.disabled=pos===0; nextB.disabled=spread?pos===sheets.length:pos===sheets.length-1;
  }
  function go(to){
    var max=spread?sheets.length:sheets.length-1; to=Math.max(0,Math.min(max,to)); if(to===pos||busy) return;
    var dir=to>pos?1:-1;
    /* the sheet that moves goes on top while turning */
    var moving=dir>0?sheets.slice(pos,to):sheets.slice(to,pos);
    moving.forEach(function(s,i){ s.style.zIndex=1000+(dir>0?i:moving.length-i); s.classList.add('moving'); setTimeout(function(){s.classList.remove('moving');},950); });
    pos=to; busy=true;
    sheets.forEach(function(s,k){ s.classList.toggle('flipped',pos>k); });
    var shift=0; if(spread){ if(pos===0) shift=-pw/2; else if(pos===sheets.length) shift=pw/2; }
    bookEl.style.transform='translateX('+shift+'px)';
    setTimeout(function(){ busy=false; apply(false); },moving.length>1?950:900);
    var total=pages().length;
    if(spread){ var a=pos*2; countEl.textContent = pos===0?'1 / '+total : pos===sheets.length? total+' / '+total : a+'–'+Math.min(a+1,total)+' / '+total; }
    else countEl.textContent=(pos+1)+' / '+total;
    prevB.disabled=pos===0; nextB.disabled=spread?pos===sheets.length:pos===sheets.length-1;
  }
  function goPage(p){ go(spread?Math.ceil(p/2):p); }

  prevB.onclick=function(){ go(pos-1); };
  nextB.onclick=function(){ go(pos+1); };

  /* click / tap: right side forward, left side back; swipe on touch */
  var sx=null, sy=null, moved=false;
  bookEl.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){ sx=e.clientX; sy=e.clientY; moved=false; });
  bookEl.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){ if(sx!==null&&Math.abs(e.clientX-sx)>10) moved=true; });
  bookEl.addEventListener('pointerup',function(e){
    if(sx===null) return; var dx=e.clientX-sx, dy=e.clientY-sy; sx=null;
    if(e.target.closest('a')) return;
    var jump=e.target.closest('[data-page]'); if(jump&&!moved){ goPage(+jump.getAttribute('data-page')); return; }
    if(moved&&Math.abs(dx)>40&&Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)){ go(dx<0?pos+1:pos-1); return; }
    if(moved) return;
    var r=bookEl.getBoundingClientRect(), x=e.clientX-r.left;
    var mid=spread?r.width/2:r.width*.35;
    go(x>mid?pos+1:pos-1);
  });
  root.tabIndex=0;
  root.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){ if(e.key==='ArrowRight'){go(pos+1);e.preventDefault();} if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'){go(pos-1);e.preventDefault();} });

  var tm, lastKey='';
  window.addEventListener('resize',function(){ clearTimeout(tm); tm=setTimeout(function(){
    var key=root.clientWidth+'x'+window.innerHeight; if(key===lastKey) return; lastKey=key; build(currentPage()); },200); });
  build(0);
})();
</script>
